name: entroly
description: Automatic, evidence-bounded context activation and auditable context operations for AI coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Activate bounded repo context before each task
interface.longDescription: Runs local context selection from a host lifecycle hook, records activation receipts, and provides auditable context operations. Receipts report observed selection and never claim provider savings without a matched baseline.
defaultPrompt: Show whether Entroly activated for this repository and explain the latest receipt.
Select the most relevant repository evidence for this task within a 1200-token budget.
Audit this task's context cost without making unsupported savings claims.
